meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

вовремя.gloss: on time, at the right moment

meanings.en: on time, at the right moment

examples.text: Ну как же ты не вовремя! Где ты сейчас?
examples.trans: Your timing couldn't be worse! Where are you now?

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

выдать.gloss: to issue, give out, hand out

examples.trans: The cashier issued the money against the receipt.

examples.text: Ну что, судьба тебе сдачу выдала!
examples.trans: Well then, fate gave you change back!

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.

examples.text: Я уже не могу готовить, стирать, убирать. Я хочу на море!
examples.trans: I can't take the cooking, washing and cleaning any more. I want to go to the sea!

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
+ dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

examples.trans: We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я уже знаю. Мне звонили из мэрии.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I already know. The town hall called me.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

examples.text: Вот именно. Но мне сдаваться нельзя.
examples.trans: Exactly. But I must not give up.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: There is no compromising material on him at all. Just an ordinary guy.

examples.text: Я просто пошла на обычный концерт.
examples.trans: I simply went to an ordinary concert.

meanings.en: to be running late, to arrive late

examples.trans: Listen, I really am running late.

examples.text: Ладно, Артурик. Послушай, я правда опаздываю.
examples.trans: All right, Arturik. Listen, I really am running late.

meanings.note: reason offered to explain or excuse conduct

examples.text: Но у меня было уважительное оправдание.

examples.text: Я хочу работать поваром в ресторане.

examples.text: Он устроил беспорядки прямо на городской улице.
examples.trans: He caused disturbances right on the city street.

related.gloss: to get a job, settle in

examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.note: в форме = in good shape; не в форме = out of shape, off one's game

examples.text: Шеф, мне не выдали форму вовремя.
examples.trans: Chef, they did not issue my uniform on time.

examples.trans: Gum? I didn't have enough money.

examples.trans: Are you joking? Seriously, tell me, where's the money? They hired me.

points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: Takes the person beaten as a direct object: обыграть кого-то. Perfective (one completed win), paired with обыгрывать.
